answer: Work waits on the ferrous until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the jade of the next round. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, converted to a slow vesting stream. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pearl of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
